title: Automated γ′ Phase Segmentation in Nickel-based Superalloys Using Detectron2 for Materials Informatics: Supporting Data and Code
description: Supporting data and code for the manuscript "Automated γ′ Phase Segmentation in Nickel-based Superalloys Using Detectron2 for Materials Informatics". The repository contains code, annotations, dataset-version documentation, fixed train/validation split information, evaluation outputs, figures, trained-model artifacts where applicable, and reproducibility resources. The manuscript experiments used the original 99-image dataset with an 80/19 training-validation split. A later expanded 110-image dataset and associated 88/22 split are documented separately and are provided as subsequent research-development materials.
notes: This release distinguishes the original 99-image manuscript experiment from the subsequently expanded 110-image dataset and associated workflow. Third-party SEM micrographs are subject to the copyright and licensing terms of their original sources and are not redistributed where permission or licensing does not permit redistribution.
